ranked_hypotheses.replication: direction consistent on fold1 before fold2; positive three-fold expected value before folds3/4

ranked_hypotheses.control: exact frozen clean C1 Plain CatBoost without39; matrix/IDs/source/settings proven before fit
ranked_hypotheses.representation: 13 ratings x Class/Type of Travel/Customer Type; label-free ix_*

ranked_hypotheses.conditional_choice: compact classical replay iff A2 pooled gain>=0.00003 and >=4/5 positive; otherwise if B1 fails one route+13 fold-safe auxiliary EV TabPFN representation
ranked_hypotheses.fallback_mechanism: Predicted covariate ratings convey conditional denoising unseen by current TabPFN; FIT probabilities inner OOS and applied probabilities outer-FIT-only; no satisfaction or ID in upstream models
ranked_hypotheses.probe: 100000 label-agnostic FIT rows/1024 apply rows; no AUC; unchanged checkpoint, categorical maps, seed1201 and resource guards

weight_policy: sensitivity only; freeze50/50 if gains<0.00003 or inconsistent; selected alternative requires fresh independent confirmation with base-level exclusion, not meta-only CV

serious_finalist_gate.independent_check: untouched shadow fold(s), exact frozen recipe; observed shadow0/1 not treated as new holdout

termination: No automatic fourth branch; close falsified mechanisms. Resource-invalid controls or jobs are not negative evidence.
